researchStatus: No new gait candidate accepted; public support trial remains withdrawn; no game core/default changes.

invalidEarlierExperiment.reason: Prototype replacement was shadowed by own observer wrappers. These rows do not establish candidate execution or effects. Earlier contact-air prototype-only rows likewise invalid.

gaitIsolation.scope: Shared original THREE/config/contact modules; all copied Gait method implementations replace observed dispatch only after matched native checkpoint, preserving ledger wrappers. Candidate update execution is mandatory. Contact-only adds AND !actual.hasSupport solely to air; load candidates also select/defer/preload catch during levH>0.

tests.name: isolated force, momentum, work and restore
gravity and potential use actual COM
world inertia and torque impulse include nonidentity principal frame
off-center impulse, angular origin and exact kinetic increment
reset force and torque books preserve independent native resets
paired common-point force cancels total impulse/moment while doing work
deferred additional mass is recorded without recomputation
post-physics setAngvel override is distinct from force work
observed replacement executes inside the same wrapper and force path; undo restores dispatch
observed replacement rejects unsafe phase, unknown/overwritten wrappers and invalid undo lifetime
actual game instrumentation preserves identical seeded body trace

rawStorage: Large raw files remain local outside the repository; hashes and reproducible code are saved here, not a claim of independent raw-file backup.
